newsitem.title: NORWAY: N. Sea Statfjord, Gullfaks oil loadings normal.
newsitem.headline: N. Sea Statfjord, Gullfaks oil loadings normal.

text.p: Oil production and tanker loadings at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields were normal on Sunday, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said.
"They have the best weather out there for two weeks. Everything is normal and there are one or two tankers loading," a Statoil spokesman said.
North Sea loadings are often disrupted in the winter months due to high winds and swell. The maximum wave height for shuttle tankers to moor up to the offshore buoys is 4.5 metres.
